signature: SUBROUTINE ZROT( N, CX, INCX, CY, INCY, C, S )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of elements in the vectors `CX` and `CY`.

params.name: x
params.reference: On input, the vector X. On output, `CX` is overwritten with $C \, X + S \, Y$.

params.name: incx
params.reference: The increment between successive values of `CX`. `INCX` \<\> 0.

params.name: y
params.reference: On input, the vector Y. On output, `CY` is overwritten with $-\overline{S} \, X + C \, Y$.

params.name: incy
params.reference: The increment between successive values of `CY`. `INCX` \<\> 0.

params.name: s
params.reference:
C and S define a rotation

$$
\begin{bmatrix} C & S \\ -\overline{S} & C \end{bmatrix}
$$

where $C \, C + S \, \overline{S} = 1.0$.
